strata.query: AREA[StudyType]INTERVENTIONAL AND (multiomics OR "multi-omics" OR proteomics OR metabolomics) AND aging
AREA[StudyType]INTERVENTIONAL AND ("precision oncology" OR genomic) AND cancer
AREA[StudyType]INTERVENTIONAL AND (nutrition OR diet) AND microbiome
AREA[StudyType]INTERVENTIONAL AND ("sequential multiple assignment" OR "SMART trial")
(AREA[StudyType]OBSERVATIONAL OR AREA[StudyType]INTERVENTIONAL) AND (EEG OR electroencephalography OR neuroimaging OR "brain imaging") AND (diagnostic OR diagnosis)
AREA[StudyType]INTERVENTIONAL AND ("transcranial magnetic stimulation" OR "deep brain stimulation" OR "transcranial direct current stimulation")

selection: Fixed stratum order; exact API response order; first 20 globally unique identifiers per stratum; no outcome-based exclusions or replacement. API sort is that of existing snapshot_clinicaltrials_search implementation.
shortage_rule: Keep actual count and report shortage; no padding, query changes, or replacement strata.
failure_rule: Preserve selected identity even if fetch or compilation fails; no replacement.
probes: remove enrollmentInfo from derived registry record: population must remain unknown and no promotion
duplicate intervention list entries in derived registry record: sparse payload must remain identical
reverse arm/intervention/outcome row order in derived record: sparse payload must remain identical
scope: Public registry intake/parser and sparse compiler only; no biological calibration, intervention execution or global winners.
